brief.vibe: A dark health tech landing: navy field, a coral and teal particle body cloud floating behind big rounded sans type, pill buttons with arrows, mono small caps eyebrows; clean, product marketing, 2019 startup.
brief.hero: Single object hero: the particle body (a 3D point cloud figure) sits centre right behind a left aligned three line H1, an eyebrow rule label, a paragraph and two pill buttons; nav is a centred pill bar with the purchase pill at right.
brief.type: Space Grotesk headings at very large size with Inter Tight body and a mono for eyebrows and micro labels; set piece is the oversized three line H1 over the particle body.
brief.palette: Dark navy field (070B1A, 0E1B3A) with one coral accent FF6A4D on the button and the particle body, teal 22C7D6 highlights, near white F7FAFC type.
brief.motion: The particle body orbits and reveals on scroll (3D and WebGL signature), percentage counter loader into a curtain lift, pill buttons with arrow nudge; conventional SaaS motion.
brief.speech: Benefit H1 with a time promise ("See how you move, in about two minutes"); CTAs "PURCHASE A PLAN" (arrow) and "BUY NOW"; sections as short imperatives ("Scan. Score. Replay.") and noun phrases ("Nothing to strap on"); blog titles as explainers ("What a Mobility Score measures", "Why ..."); a press line in the hero band.
brief.rhythm: Centered content column with a three step strip, plan cards in a row, alternating feature blocks; the particle object recurs on every page hero.
